{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What's wrong, Dian?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I have a request. Please, let me go to that village. ...I beg you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}　｛Let's go to the village｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛Do your hero's duty　　｝{n}{end}
{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}All right, let's go to the village. We'd better hurry. I'll take you there with my power!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6780}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}This seems to be it... The air is stagnant...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Villager: What, are you a traveler? {fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Um, Dian...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not in the mood to talk, so would you leave me alone...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian... What happened was truly unfortunate...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}It's all right... now...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I just want to think by myself for now. Please leave me alone...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}　｛Comfort him｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛Leave　　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}It wasn't your fault. I think there was just a bit of a misunderstanding.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}So...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}What could you possibly understand?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}You don't understand anything...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I can't bear people's unreasonable cruelty anymore...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}It's the same as that time... The time Liza was killed...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Liza...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...She was once my assistant, and also my beloved...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}She lost her life to the same kind of cruelty...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Several years ago, we were working in a village to treat a mysterious disease that struck only children.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}But no one knew what the disease was. There was nothing I could do, and many died.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Then the village turned against us more and more, and the hostility grew.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}At that time, a child died right in front of us...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:9F03}{spk:0080}{n}Perhaps from the shock of losing her child, the mother blamed us for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A003}{spk:0080}{n}We could only apologize. At the time, there was nothing else we could do...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A103}{spk:0080}{n}But the mother would not forgive us.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0380}{n}{e0:A203}{spk:0080}{n}Suddenly, the mother went mad and slashed at me with a blade...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A303}{spk:0080}{n}...If only I had been stabbed then...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A403}{spk:0080}{n}But at that moment, it was Liza who threw herself in front of me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A503}{spk:0080}{n}A cold blade in Liza's chest...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A603}{spk:0080}{n}Limp in my arms, Liza slowly breathed her last...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A703}{spk:0080}{n}A few days later, unable to bear the grief, I quietly left the village. Leaving my patients behind...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A803}{spk:0080}{n}A few days before Liza was killed, when I had given up and wanted to leave, she told me she wanted to save the children somehow.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:A903}{spk:0080}{n}No matter how close I came to giving up, she always said it, so firmly!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:AA03}{spk:0080}{n}...So why!! Why did someone so kind have to be killed?!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:AB03}{spk:0080}{n}When she was killed, what did God or good people ever do for her?! No one... nothing...!!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:AC03}{spk:0080}{n}I learned... In this world there are unjust deaths, and likewise unjust lives...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}This is what I gained from my own experience. It may not be moral...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...That's all I wanted to tell you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...Please calm down, Dian. I understand your grief and anger.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}But please don't fall into such extreme thinking now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I understand... Please give me some time...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Yes, please rest, Dian...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I will...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}What? Are you saying my thinking is wrong?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}So even you won't understand me?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian... That's not...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I understand perfectly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Justice, morality... That's all just empty talk!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I can't bear to believe in such things and live for foolish people anymore!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I... I'm done living for others!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e9:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0780}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}(It can't be helped... I'll leave him alone for today...){n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian, I'll come again... Please feel better...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Yes, goodbye...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
